title: Regional Model Economics & Competitive Triggers Playbook
creator: Ivy Chen
description:
Objective: Produce a concise, operational playbook that maps regional model economics (latency, token cost, inference throughput) to competitive triggers and suggested Redwood actions. Scope includes NA/EU/APAC region breakdowns, 3 representative customer personas (startup, midmarket, enterprise), and a prioritized set of automated alert rules for the model-scout pipeline.

Deliverables: 1) Executive one-pager (confluence) summarizing top 6 regional risks/opportunities; 2) a scoring rubric for model substitution risk (latency + cost + feature delta); 3) rule set for automated watchtower alerts with suggested runbooks; 4) sample dashboard mock for Console showing regional cost vs. latency swap curves.

Success criteria: Playbook adopted by product & sales (measured by 2 demo integrations and 1 pilot automated alert configured in watchtower), and a validated hypothesis that switching to a fallback model in APAC reduces 95p latency by >=30% for at least one enterprise customer without increasing unit cost by >10%.

Scope exclusions: Not covering model licensing negotiations, not implementing infra changes — this is a product + GTM playbook that produces clear engineering tickets for any infra work implied.

Stakeholders: Product (Marco, Priya), Market Intelligence (Aisha), Eng runtime leads (Kai, Jun), Solutions/SE (Lena), Sales AE pilot owners (Rohan).

Artifacts and links: Confluence draft: https://redwood.atl/confluence/regional-model-econ-playbook (draft), GSheet model-cost matrix: https://drive.google.com/redwood/model-cost-matrix, sample GitHub PR for alert schema: https://github.com/redwood-inference/watchtower/pull/284
updates: 2026-03-11 - Kickoff: aligned on scope with Eng and Sales. Agreed to focus first on three models (open Llama-like, mid-tier performant, and small low-latency embedder) across 3 regions.
2026-03-12 - Data run: Eng provided token-level p50/p95 latency per model for NA/EU/APAC. Observed APAC tail latency is 2.2x NA for the mid-tier model under baseline batching.
2026-03-12 - Decision: include a model-variant compatibility column (quantized vs float16) in the scoring rubric to reflect fallback cost/quality trade-offs.

2026-03-13 - PM review: added customer persona vignettes to estimate tolerance for quality vs cost. Startup persona tolerates up to 20% quality delta for 40% cost savings; enterprise persona tolerance <5%.
2026-03-14 - Design feedback (Lena): Console mock should visualize 'cost per 1k requests' and 'median latency' with an overlay for SLA breach risk. Added to mock checklist.
2026-03-14 - Risk noted: Some APAC regions use older GPU instance types in partner clouds — need ENG confirmation on quantization compatibility. Added ENG-60109 as dependency.

2026-03-15 - External signal: spotted a competitor announcement about a new low-latency quantized runtime for APAC — added as watch item; recommended elevating alert priority for APAC fallback triggers.
2026-03-15 - Next steps: finalize scoring rubric and sample alert logic, produce one-pager draft, and schedule review with Sales pilot leads on 2026-03-22.
notes: This ticket is intended to bridge product, solutions, and runtime engineering for a set of operational rules that can be converted into watchtower alerts and Console actionables. Keep the playbook concise (2-4 pages plus appendix) so Sales can consume it during pilot conversations.
